ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Medians $BD$ and $CE$ of triangle $ABC$ are perpendicular, with $BD=8$ and $CE=12$. Find the area of triangle $ABC$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle ABC, D is on side AC, and E is on side AB; segments BD and CE intersect at point G, and there is a right-angle mark at the intersection point, indicating BD ⟂ CE. The problem statement explains that BD and CE are medians of triangle ABC, and BD=8, CE=12. Reasoning: The two medians intersect at centroid G. The centroid divides each median in a 2:1 ratio from the vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side, so BG=(2/3)BD=(2/3)·8=16/3, CG=(2/3)CE=(2/3)·12=8. Since BD ⟂ CE, BG ⟂ CG, triangle BGC is a right triangle, and its area is (1/2)·BG·CG=(1/2)·(16/3)·8=64/3. Connecting the centroid to the three vertices divides triangle ABC into three triangles of equal area, therefore [BGC]=[ABC]/3. Thus [ABC]=3·(64/3)=64.

raw_record.question_text: Medians $BD$ and $CE$ of triangle $ABC$ are perpendicular, with $BD=8$ and $CE=12$. Find the area of triangle $ABC$.

method.method_draft: Use the centroid area partition. From the diagram/text, identify BD and CE as medians meeting at G and perpendicular, with BD=8 and CE=12. Since the centroid divides each median in a 2:1 ratio from the vertex, BG=(2/3)BD=16/3 and CG=(2/3)CE=8. Because the medians are perpendicular, triangle BGC is right, so its area is (1/2)(16/3)(8)=64/3. Use the fact that the centroid divides triangle ABC into three equal-area triangles when joined to the vertices, so [BGC]=[ABC]/3. Therefore [ABC]=3(64/3)=64.

method.method_draft: Set up coordinates with the centroid G as the origin and the two perpendicular medians as coordinate axes. Put BD on the y-axis and CE on the x-axis. Since the centroid divides medians in a 2:1 ratio, choose B=(0,16/3), D=(0,-8/3), C=(8,0), and E=(-4,0). Because D is the midpoint of AC, solve A=2D-C=(-8,-16/3). Then compute the area of triangle ABC using the determinant formula: area = (1/2)|det(B-A, C-A)|. Here B-A=(8,32/3) and C-A=(16,16/3), so the determinant is 8(16/3)-(32/3)(16)=-128 in absolute value, giving area 64.
